---
name: Math or content error
about: Something on the site is mathematically wrong, misleading, or unclear
title: '[lecture-NN] '
labels: content
---

**Where**: page URL and the exact sentence, formula, figure, or code block.

**What is wrong**: quote it, then say what is incorrect or misleading.

**The correct version**: if you can, show the correction, with the computation or proof that
settles it. Disagreements about math are settled by proof or computation here, so this section
does most of the work.
